+def test_build_and_install_symlinks(collection_input, tmp_path):
+    input_dir, output_dir = collection_input
+    os.makedirs(os.path.join(input_dir, 'playbooks', 'roles'))
+    os.symlink(os.path.join(input_dir, 'roles'), os.path.join(input_dir, 'playbooks', 'roles', 'linked'))
+    os.symlink(os.path.join(input_dir, 'README.md'), os.path.join(input_dir, 'docs', 'linked.md'))
+    outside = tmp_path / 'outside.txt'
+    outside.write_text('external content')
+    os.symlink(str(outside), os.path.join(input_dir, 'docs', 'external.txt'))
+
+    collection.build_collection(input_dir, output_dir, False)
+    artifact = os.path.join(output_dir, 'ansible_namespace-collection-0.1.0.tar.gz')
+    with tarfile.open(artifact) as archive:
+        assert archive.getmember('playbooks/roles/linked').issym()
+        assert archive.getmember('docs/linked.md').issym()
+        assert archive.getmember('docs/external.txt').isreg()
+
+    requirement = collection.CollectionRequirement.from_tar(to_bytes(artifact), True)
+    install_root = tmp_path / 'installed'
